tier_reason: The only harness behind the numbers (ketotek/crypto-bench) performs no output check, feeds never-initialized key and input buffers to Botan and libgcrypt and reads Crypto++'s output through strlen on an uninitialized buffer (undefined behaviour), keys the AF_ALG row with a reduced 8-byte CAST5 key, and its pre-1.6.0 libgcrypt baseline is stale by enough (1.9.0 CAST5 40-70% faster) to erase the 1.34x gap; no valid measurement remains, so directional only.

corrections.caveats: Harness UB and unchecked output; libgcrypt baseline pre-1.6.0; counter-evidence from scc-tw/cryptobench-cpp is also flawed (8.9.0 never selects hardware crypto on Apple chips other than plain M1, #1373). No release since 8.9.0 (2023-10-01); open #1364/#1369, #1247, #1249; CAST-128 obsolescent per Crypto++.
